verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer works inside the product. Autofix scans incoming issues to find root causes and automate triage, can generate a code fix, and Seer Agent answers natural-language questions by finding the relevant telemetry. Together these are first-party AI insights and suggestions drawn from the user's own data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's insight quality, and in-depth docs on how insights are surfaced across dashboards and explore views.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
Autofix: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
PR Creation: Use Autofix to generate a code fix and create a PR.
